description: The user's boards on regards.design, where they keep sections they liked: each board's id, name, how many sections it holds, whether it is shared by link, and its page (url). last is the board save_to_board uses when none is named; most and sectionsEach are how many boards the plan keeps (null: as many as the user likes) and how many sections each holds. Use it to find a board the user names ("my Pricing board") or to see what they have kept; read_board gives a board's sections.
name: list_boards

boards.description: The user's boards, the last changed first.

shared.description: Whether anyone with its link can open it (the user turns sharing on and off on its page).

url.description: Its page on regards.design: the user's own, and anyone's while it is shared.

canShare.description: Whether the plan shares boards by link.

last.description: The id of the board save_to_board uses when none is named; null before the first save.

most.description: How many boards the plan keeps; null: as many as the user likes.

sectionsEach.description: How many sections each board holds.

title: Your boards
